author: Blog Staff
description:
C++26 reflection opens the door to rethinking patterns that traditionally require mountains of boilerplate, including type erasure. The rjk::duck library puts that capability to work, using reflection to provide flexible, customizable type erasure with the performance of traditional vtable dispatch.

Beautiful Type Erasure with C++26 Reflection

by Ryan Keane

From the article:

If you’ve ever tried using type erasure for something more complicated than std::any or std::function, you’ve either written 100+ lines of easy-to-mess-up code or reached for a boilerplate-heavy library like Boost.TypeErasure or Folly.Poly.
title: Beautiful Type Erasure with C++26 Reflection -- Ryan Keane

Upcoming C++ User Group Meetings in September

by Jens Weller

From the article:

The monthly overview on upcoming C++ User Group meetings! C++ Brno Meetup is a newly registered group having their 10th meetup!

If you'd like to start your own C++ User Group, one of the best places to get started with your network is Meeting C++ 2026 in Berlin, Meeting C++ is also happy to support your new group. You can also find various articles about starting and running in the user group section of Meeting C++.
title: Upcoming C++ User Group meetings in September 2026
